content: Hello, this is Danielle from Amazon's Legal & Regulatory Department. I'm contacting you about a recent issue with your Amazon account regarding a delayed order.
Hi. I did get an email about a delay. Is there something wrong with my order?
Thank you for confirming. According to our system, your package is on hold due to a pending international customs verification, per Amazon Policy 14B-7. It's a standard process for new account users.
Oh, I didn't know about that. It's my first order with this account.

That's perfectly understandable. Since this is your first time using a shared account, our policies require us to verify your identity and process a regulatory clearance. Could I ask you to confirm your full name and the shipping address on file?
Sure, my name is Jason Lee, and the shipping address is 1025 Maple Drive, Apt 2B.

Thank you, Jason. I've updated our system. To lift the hold, Amazon requires a temporary customs fee of $125, which is fully refundable after verification. This is outlined in Policy 14B-7. Would you like me to guide you through the payment process?
Um, do I have to pay it? I've never had to do this before.

I completely understand your concern, Jason. This is a one-time measure for first-time shared account users making cross-border purchases. Once the payment is received, your order will be released immediately and the fee will be refunded within 24 hours. Your account remains safe throughout.
Okay. How do I pay the customs fee?
Amazon partners with secure payment channels for regulatory fees. For your convenience, you may use Amazon gift cards or, if you prefer, a Zelle transfer. Which method would you like to use?
I guess I can do an Amazon gift card. How does that work?
That's a great choice, Jason. Please purchase Amazon gift cards totaling $125 from any store or online. Once you have the cards, just share the claim codes with me here for processing.
Okay, so I just need to buy the cards and send you the numbers?
Exactly. I'll process the codes securely through our regulatory portal, and you'll receive a confirmation email for your records. Let me know when you have the cards ready.
Alright, can I do it online and get the codes?
Yes, purchasing them online is fast and convenient. Once you receive the digital codes, simply copy and paste them here. I'm here to assist you every step of the way.
Thanks. Should I get one card for $125 or several smaller ones?
You may get one $125 card or multiple cards that total $125, it's entirely up to you. Both options are accepted under Amazon Policy 14B-7.
Okay, I'll start the purchase now. Do you need anything else from me?
Just to make sure we process the refund correctly, could you also confirm the email address associated with your Amazon account?
It's jason.lee@university.edu.
Thank you, Jason. Whenever you have the gift card codes ready, please share them here. I'll handle the rest and keep you updated on every step. Your refund and order release will be prioritized.
Alright, I'm buying the cards now. I'll send the codes as soon as I get them.
Perfect. Please let me know if you have any questions. Your satisfaction and security are our top priorities.
